description: Institutional holdings from a fund manager's latest SEC 13F-HR: the information table parsed from EDGAR, aggregated by CUSIP (issuer, class, shares, USD value, portfolio weight, put/call, voting authority), with filing period, totals, amendment and recent-filing links. Look up by manager name or CIK, or pin a specific accession. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sec-13f

accession.description: Specific 13F-HR accession number (e.g. 0001193125-26-352200); default = latest original 13F-HR

fund.description: Investment manager name or CIK (e.g. Berkshire Hathaway, 1067983). Aliases: cik, manager

limit.description: Top holdings to return by value (1-500, default 25)
